description: Bedrock resources are configured, but model invocation logging is not enabled
rationale: Bedrock resources exist in this Region and the logging configuration was successfully read with no modality enabled. Resource presence does not prove recent model invocation; Bedrock-Mantle requests and some operations are not covered by model invocation logging.
remediation: Review usage and data classification. If appropriate, enable Bedrock invocation logging to encrypted S3 or CloudWatch Logs, enforce access controls and retention for potentially sensitive model input/output. Verify CloudTrail data events independently.
